artworks.title: Christ Tells His Disciples of the Last Judgment
artworks.creditLine: Print Purchase Fund (Pepita Milmore Memorial Fund)
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a group of robed figures gathered around a table in an architectural setting. The figures are dressed in flowing robes and holding staffs or long objects, engaging in an activity in the center of the room. The background features arches, a column, and a grid-like pattern on the windows, creating depth in the space. The lines are crisp and include crosshatching to show shadows and depth.

artworks.title: Christ Tells His Disciples of the Last Judgment
artworks.creditLine: Print Purchase Fund (Pepita Milmore Memorial Fund)
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a group of individuals engaging in a narrative scene with architectural elements in the background. The drawing is rendered in black and white with a rich use of line and texture to convey detail and depth. The central focus appears to be on interaction and movement, with characters wearing period attire. The scene is composed with a balance of light and shadow, enhancing the drama of the visual story.

artworks.title: Christ Tells His Disciples of the Last Judgment
artworks.description: This is a drawing of an animated scene featuring multiple figures dressed in historical or medieval attire. The figures are gathered around a central middle figure, who appears to be in motion or distress. The scene is set against an architectural backdrop with arches and elevated structures. The characters are detailed with textured fabrics and hair, and the drawing includes sharp lines and shading for depth and detail.

artworks.title: The Four Horsemen of the Apocalypse
The Four Horsemen of the Apocalypse
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a fantastical beast with multiple heads confronting a group of figures. The image features a creature with seven heads, each crowned, and a body that appears to be a blend of various animals, standing aggressively with multiple serpentine necks. The background depicts rocky formations and a sunburst-like design at the top of the composition. The group of figures on the left are arranged closely, with expressions of surprise or curiosity, dressed in medieval-style robes and garments. The contrast of light and shadow is created by fine lines and hatching, typical of engravings or woodcut artwork, adding a dramatic and intense atmosphere. The setting suggests an allegorical or mythological scene.

artworks.title: The Four Horsemen of the Apocalypse
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a battle scene with angelic figures. The image shows several armored angelic beings engaging in combat. Some are wielding swords and shields, while one is subduing another figure. Above them, an angel holds a trumpet surrounded by clouds. On the right side, a crowned figure watches over the scene from a raised platform. The drawing is full of movement and energy, with swirling clouds and muscular figures. The linework and shading emphasize tension and dramatic action.

artworks.title: The Four Horsemen of the Apocalypse
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a winged creature engaging in a struggle with a figure in flowing robes. The scene is set against a dynamic landscape with swirling clouds overhead and a cityscape in the background. Other figures are also present in the drawing. The line work and shading are detailed and intricate.

artworks.title: The Four Horsemen of the Apocalypse
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a robed figure writing in a book while an ethereal figure appears in the clouds above. The drawing depicts a seated figure with large feathered wings, dressed in flowing robes, holding a quill to a book or scroll resting on a rock. The scene is set amidst a dramatic landscape, with a mountainous background and a body of water behind the figure. To the left, the landscape features trees and shrubs, while to the right of the figure, there appears to be a mythical creature with wings. In the sky above, a smaller figure surrounded by radiant light is visible. The use of line work and shading is intricate.

artworks.title: The Waterfall and Town of Tivoli
artworks.medium: pen and brown ink with brown and gray wash over black chalk, squared for transfer with red chalk, on laid paper
artworks.description: The image shows a landscape sketch of a town built on a rugged cliffside. The scene features closely clustered buildings with dark rooftops, an arched structure, and rolling hills in the background. The drawing style consists of loose brushstrokes and crosshatching in sepia and earthy tones, creating an impressionistic and dynamic look. The sketch displays architectural detail with quick brushwork, giving the scene a lively quality.

artworks.title: Ruins by a Woodland Stream
artworks.medium: pen and black ink with gray wash on laid paper
artworks.description: The image depicts a dense forest with an old stone structure among the trees, viewed from ground level. The canopy obscures the horizon, creating an intimate and enclosed atmosphere. The foliage and branches are intricately detailed, with the ruins shaded to show age and texture. Delicate brushstrokes capture the play of light and shadow on the trunks and leaves precisely. The color palette is monochromatic, in shades of gray, creating a tranquil setting. Soft light filters through the trees, illuminating parts of the ruins and forest floor. Figures are engaged in quiet activity in the background.

artworks.title: Port of San Remo
artworks.description: The image depicts a coastal scene from above eye level. The shoreline is visible with sailboats on the left. The horizon is low, with the sky dominating the top. In the distance to the right, there is a domed building. The intricate brushstrokes show texture, including ripples in the water and clouds in the sky. The color palette is black and off-white, emphasizing light and shadows. Faint outlines of buildings and ships are in the distance.

artworks.title: The Blind Prince
artworks.description: The image shows a central seated figure on an elevated throne-like chair. The central figure has a beard and curly hair, dressed in a robe, holding a long staff. Surrounding him are at least fifteen standing individuals, most with beards and curly hair, wearing long robes and cloaks. Some figures are closely positioned together. In the background, there is an architectural structure with columns and arches, with a draped cloth above the group. Inscriptions in frames at the base and side of the image, two arches in the background.

artworks.title: Rooftops, St. Cloud
artworks.medium: watercolor over graphite on wove paper
artworks.description: The image is from a higher vantage point, showing rooflines with red-orange terracotta tiles, vegetation, and chimney pots. The brushwork appears gentle and slightly textured, suggesting watercolor. The color palette consists of earthy tones of browns, reds, creams, and green shades.

artworks.title: Head of a Man
artworks.description: The image shows a drawing of a person's head in profile, capturing only the head and neck area. The person is positioned facing left with their gaze directed upward. Their facial features are strongly defined, with a prominent nose and an intense furrowed brow. The hair is drawn in a manner suggesting the person is wearing a cap or some covering over their head. The drawing is rendered in red chalk on a lightly textured background. There are no noticeable jewelry or objects held by the person in this artwork, and the background is plain.

artworks.title: Two Horses at a Watering Place (Les Deux chevaux a l'abreuvoir)
artworks.description: The image displays two horses standing in shallow water. The background shows a sloping terrain with trees or shrubbery on the horizon line. The brushstrokes are broad and textured, suggesting movement in the water. The color palette consists of sepia tones, creating a vintage atmosphere. Trees and grasses add vertical elements to the scene, while the brushstrokes across the sky add an ethereal touch.

artworks.title: The Sacrifice of Marcus Curtius
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a scene with a horse and human figures. The composition shows a figure riding a reared-up horse, with flowing mane and tail. Another figure is reaching out towards the rider. The background features swirling forms creating a sense of motion. The drawing focuses on anatomy, motion, and expression with strong lines defining the figures. It has a monochromatic color scheme and a style reminiscent of the Baroque period.

artworks.title: Fumette
artworks.medium: etching in brown on wove paper
artworks.description: The image displays a woman sitting with her arms on her lap, hands folded together. She has distinct facial features, focused expression, prominent eyes, and wavy hair. She wears a long dress with patterns near the chest and sleeves. The background is plain with a subtle texture around her, emphasizing the woman's figure and details.

artworks.title: Self-Portrait
artworks.medium: black chalk with touches of red chalk on buff laid paper
artworks.description: The image shows a drawing of a person's upper body, with the view angled slightly from the side. The person's head is turned towards the viewer, allowing their facial features to be visible. They have an oval face, a straight nose, and full lips, with a direct gaze. Their hair is long, wavy, and falls gracefully past their shoulders. The individual is draped in a garment that covers their shoulders and is gently drawn around their neck. Their hands are partially visible, one resting atop the other. The background is plain.

artworks.title: Head of a Young Woman
artworks.medium: black and red chalk on laid paper
artworks.description: The image shows a close-up profile of a person's face, extending to part of their neck and shoulder. The person has a smooth, round face with a soft jawline, a prominent and slightly elongated nose, and full lips. The eyes are delicately depicted, looking ahead. The person wears a cloth cap covering most of their hair, with a few strands visible. The cap appears to be sheer with subtle textures. There are no visible accessories. The background is plain and neutral.

artworks.title: The Departure of the Prodigal Son
artworks.medium: pen and brown ink with brown wash heightened with white on laid paper
artworks.description: The image shows two robed figures meeting in an outdoor architectural setting. The background features archways, columns, and stone buildings. The central figures are engaged in a discussion, with one extending a hand towards the other. One figure has a pointed beard and a large hat, while the other is bald. Other figures are present, with one holding dogs. The scene has depth, with figures in the foreground and background. The drawing is detailed, depicting ornate attire and architectural elements.

artworks.title: The Apotheosis of San Vitale
artworks.medium: pen and brown ink with brown wash over black chalk on laid paper
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a celestial scene with figures amidst clouds. The composition depicts a central figure holding a staff or sceptre, elevated above others on a cloud, surrounded by smaller figures that appear to be angels or cherubs. These figures are on both sides and below the central figure, all in dynamic poses. Rays of light are suggested coming from above, illuminating the scene, and the background is filled with additional clouds and some hints of sky or heavenly elements. The use of ink creates strong, flowing lines that define the forms and suggest movement. The overall composition is circular, concentrating focus towards the central figure.

artworks.title: Saint Francis
artworks.artist: Pieter Claesz Soutman after Francesco Bassano II
artworks.description: The image shows a person kneeling and leaning forward at a stone slab with a human skull on it. The individual has a solemn facial expression with defined features, including a prominent brow, full beard, thick and somewhat curly hair, and is wearing a robe with loose sleeves, a rope belt, and a halo above their head. The background is dark and textured, with light rays shining on the person. A crucifix partially overlaps the skull to the right.

artworks.title: Virgin and Angels Watching Over the Sleeping Infant Jesus
artworks.description: The image shows a group of four figures from their waists upwards. Three figures are seated while one stands. They are gathered around a sleeping child on a soft surface, possibly a cushion. The child has a serene expression, eyes closed, and curled hair. One figure seated on the right holds the child, while another on the left looks at them. The background figure stands with voluminous hair and large wings. All figures are dressed in flowing garments with intricate folds. The setting appears to be an interior space with a hint of a landscape seen through a window or arch in the background.

artworks.title: Battle of the Sea Gods [left half]
artworks.dimensions: sheet (trimmed within plate mark): 28.6 x 42.6 cm (11 1/4 x 16 3/4 in.)
artworks.description: Printed with black ink on light tan paper, this horizontal engraving shows a tight group of three muscular men riding imaginary creatures and an old woman standing behind them to our left, all with mouths dropped wide open. The men are spaced evenly across the picture, and they and the woman are all nude. The man on our left faces us and rides a scale-covered creature. The animal has a fish tail at the back and long talons at the front. The dragon-like mouth gapes open, and a forked tongue flicks out over sharp teeth. The rider holds the reins of the snarling creature in one hand and holds a tall staff in the other. The old woman stands behind him with one foot on the creature’s back. Her other leg is hidden by that man’s body. The woman’s long hair flows back from her wrinkled face, and her long, thin breasts droop off her emaciated body. Her jaw drops open, and her gaunt cheeks are hollow. She holds a fluttering cloak in her right hand, closer to us, and in the other, she holds out a sign about the size of a postcard that reads “INVID.” The sign hangs from a ribbon over the head of the man in the middle who engages with the third man to the right. They both ride animals with horses’ bodies and coiling serpents’ tails. The men and steeds face each other, also with mouths wide open and teeth bared. The man in the center holds a bunch of fish up behind his head in one hand. The third man’s cloak swirls behind his head as he lunges forward, thrusting a rod at the man in the middle. The hair, beards, and ears of these two men are formed by leaves. Beyond these two stands a sculpture of a naked man seen from the back. His head is turned to our left to look at the trident he holds in that hand, while the other cradles what appears to be a small dolphin. He stands on a tall base and an oval frame, perhaps a mirror, hangs on the wall opposite him among a bank of reeds. The ground around and under the animals is made of wavy lines to suggest water. A hill to our left and buildings atop a mountain at the center are far in the distance and deep in shadow. The artist used dense areas of thin black lines to build the shadows in the background and on the people and creatures.
